page.title: Jane Doe
page.lead: '''Jane Doe''' (born 15 March 1998) is an Indian software engineer known for her work on open-source tooling.{{cite|r1}} She is a maintainer of several widely used build tools and has spoken at developer conferences across Asia and Europe.{{cite|r2}}

sections.heading: Early life and education
sections.content:
Doe was born in [[Mumbai]], [[India]], to a family of teachers.{{cite|r1}} She attended a local school before studying computer science at [[IIT Bombay]], where she graduated in 2020.

During her studies she contributed to ''several'' open-source projects and won a national programming contest.

sections.heading: Career
sections.content:
In 2020 she joined a Bengaluru-based startup as a backend engineer.{{cite|r2}} Her notable work includes:

* Built a fast incremental build system
* Led the migration of the company's services to a new runtime
* Mentored new contributors through community programmes

sections.heading: Open source
sections.content: Doe maintains a number of open-source libraries, which together are downloaded millions of times per week.{{cite|r1}}{{cite|r3}} She is a frequent collaborator of [[John Doe]].

sections.heading: Speaking
sections.content:
She has given talks at conferences including:

# DevConf India (2022)
# OpenTools Europe (2023)
# BuildCon (2024)

sections.heading: Personal life
sections.content: Doe lives in Bengaluru. Outside of software, she is an amateur [[Astronomy|astronomer]] and runs a [https://example.com/blog popular blog] about the night sky.
